proved_en: For every pair of natural numbers 0 <= m < n, a nondecreasing sequence a : N -> N exists such that deleting any m indexed occurrences leaves every sufficiently large natural number representable as a finite sum of remaining indexed occurrences, while deleting any n indexed occurrences destroys this property, if and only if m <= 1. The proof covers m = 0 by powers of two, m = 1 by the Fibonacci sequence 1,1,2,3,..., and impossibility for m >= 2. Deletion is Function.updateFinset a s 0; repeated values retain separate indices.
gap_en: No mathematical scope gap for JSP-000290. Use the actual set-equality target Erdos348.erdos_348 and the nondecreasing, indexed-deletion formulation.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Constructs reciprocal-sum-free subsets of {1,...,N} with asymptotic density at least 17/32 and proves that the extremal density does not tend to 1/2 (parts.ii). The audited finite inequality uses additive constant 576, not 64.
gap_en: The optimal asymptotic density and existence of its limit (parts.i) are not proved. The 5/8 lower bound and 9/10 upper bound are not established here.
campaign_result: Focused mathematical route analysis completed; no new full proof. Route tested; naive Fekete hypotheses refuted; density limit and optimal value unresolved

proved_en: Proves necessary divisibility t | choose(k+t,t-1) for (k+1)-colorability of J(2k,k), exclusions for k>2 when k+1 is composite or k is odd, the k=4 exclusion, and chromaticNumber(J(18,9)) > 10.
gap_en: Neither existence for some k > 2 nor nonexistence for all such k is proved. The general remaining prime-(k+1) cases remain uncovered. The coloring question concerns k-subsets of a 2k-set and all k+1 colors on each (k+1)-subset.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Fully disproves the scoped question: if two consecutive positive integers are powerful, must at least one be a perfect square? The counterexample is 12167 = 23^3 and 12168 = 2^3 * 39^2; both are powerful and neither is a square. The parts.i target directly proves the negation of the universal claim. Also proves infinitely many positive consecutive powerful pairs with neither member square.
gap_en: No scope gap for JSP-000301, whose review notes explicitly exclude the separate counting question. The polylogarithmic counting upper bound in Erdos 365 parts.ii is not proved; the infinite family does not imply it.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the least decreasing triple begins at n=13 and gives a decreasing quadruple at n=317. Also proves infinitely many valleys P(n)>P(n+1)<P(n+2), and infinitely many individual adjacent increases and decreases.
gap_en: Infinitely many decreasing triples are not proved; catalog scope remains unresolved.
new_proved_result: Literal existence theorem stated entirely using prime divisibility and domination of every prime divisor; witness 13,14,15.
review_note: Ready for maintainer review of complete finite existence and unresolved infinitude scope; not an award or full-infinitude claim.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the Tihany partition variants k=5, a=b=3 and independence number exactly 2.
gap_en: The conjecture for arbitrary graphs and arbitrary k,a,b is not proved. The independence-number hypothesis is a substantive restriction; the quasi-line variant is not established here.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the r=3 statement for edge colorings of K10. The target variants.r2 proves infinitely many parameters r admit an r-coloring on r^2 vertices in which every (r+1)-vertex subset contains every color; this is a counterexample family at r^2 vertices.
gap_en: The general r>=3 statement on r^2+1 vertices, including the r=4 variant, is not proved. The name r2 refers to r^2 counterexamples, not an affirmative r=2 case.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves exact maxima 1 in dimension 0 and 3 in dimension 1, six-point and eight-point constructions in dimensions 2 and 3, and a choose(n+1,2)-point isosceles construction in general dimension.
gap_en: The upper bounds proving optimality in dimensions 2 and 3 and the general upper bound are not proved. Other optimality wrappers assume hupper; the supremum lower-bound wrapper assumes BddAbove.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves infinitely many n have gcd(a_n,L_n)>1, where L_n=lcm(1,...,n) and a_n=sum_{j=1}^n L_n/j, using n=2*3^(k+1). This completes parts.ii.
gap_en: The infinitely-many coprime case (parts.i), the prime-digit equivalence, and counting or density results are not proved.
campaign_result: Focused mathematical route analysis completed; no new full proof. Unconditional finite-prime simultaneous result established on paper; full coprime infinitude unresolved

proved_en: Proves the O(n^2) bound for k<=2, disproves the universal O(n^2) claim in parts.ii, and proves an infinitely-often positive-constant n^2 log n lower bound for three consecutive B_2 factors.
gap_en: The n^(2+o(1)) question in parts.i remains unproved and undisproved; n^2 log n is compatible with that bound. Higher-full variants for r>=3 are not proved.
campaign_result: Focused mathematical route analysis completed; no new full proof. Exact structural facts and shortcut obstruction established on paper; full n^(2+o(1)) statement unresolved

proved_en: Proves property B for countably indexed families of infinite sets, and the two-set and pairwise-disjoint variants.
gap_en: The full arbitrary-index Property B proposition remains unproved. Countably infinite members do not imply a countable family or union.
campaign_result: Checked arbitrary-ground/index scope; proved disjoint-refinement reductions and explicit counterexamples to invalid union-countability, fresh-witness, compactness and naive-Zorn steps. These do not solve Property B.

proved_en: Proves the fixed one-dimensional asymptotic statement and the choose(n,2) diameter lower bound in every dimension. Derives failure of a bound uniform in dimension only under the complete Ho-construction hypothesis hHo.
gap_en: The fixed-dimension statement for d>=2 is not proved. The choose(n,2) bound has asymptotic constant 1/2. The Ho construction is assumed, and dimensions varying with n do not refute a fixed-dimension claim.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the k=0 digit-representation statement, including representation of every natural number under the reciprocal-sum condition, its converse, and the k=0 eventual-representation equivalence.
gap_en: Positive-cutoff sufficiency, {3,4,7} completeness, and Melfi construction remain unproved.
new_proved_result: Necessary gcd obstruction and explicit distinct-exponent representatives for every residue.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves infinitely many triples of positive 3-powerful integers a,b,c with a+b=c and {a,b,c}.Coprime, using a proved seed and a growing recurrence.
gap_en: The triples theorem is complete but its exact JSP scope remains unresolved. The new general r>=6 construction is a separate sum-family result; it does not resolve the scope or r=4/5 gaps.
new_proved_result: For every r>=6, infinitely many finite sets of exactly r-2 positive r-powerful terms, setwise gcd1 and r-powerful sum.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves infinite higher-powerful sum families for r=6,7,8, examples, and the negation of the assertion that every r>=4 has only finitely many solutions.
gap_en: r=4 existence, r=4/5 infinitude, full catalog counting/density questions and scope approval remain unresolved.
new_proved_result: For every r>=6, infinitely many finite sets of exactly r-2 positive r-powerful terms, setwise gcd1 and r-powerful sum.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the five-vertex case (k=1) of the triangle-free bipartite edge-deletion problem and its C5 sharpness: at least one edge must be deleted.
gap_en: The bound for all k>1, the n5 variants, and general C5-blowup tightness are not proved here.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves a maximum adjacent denominator gap of at least 2 and the sharpness witness (2,3,6) with reciprocal sum 1 and maximum gap 3. Derives the gap>=3 conclusion for sufficiently large lengths only under an additional prime-distribution conjecture.
gap_en: The original unconditional gap>=3 statement for all lengths is not proved. The prime-distribution premise and the remaining small lengths are unresolved by this file.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the Bateman counterexample: for each h>=3, a set is an ordinary asymptotic basis of order at most h but has no restricted order. Separately proves large-odd coverage and a counting bound for order-two bases containing 0, which concern Erdos 339.
gap_en: The general characterization, conditional bounds, equality and finite-deletion questions remain unproved. E339 is a separate problem.
campaign_result: Bateman’s example now has proved least ordinary order exactly h for every h>=3, and no restricted order.

proved_en: Proves the requested common prime-factor bound for i<=2 and the weaker general gcd>1 result. Proves conditional prime-factor transfer steps, explicit exceptions to the strict p>i strengthening, and necessary membership of those exceptions in any valid exception set.
gap_en: The general common-prime bound p>=i is not proved. A gcd>1 conclusion only ensures a common prime >=2; transfer results retain additional prime-existence or divisibility hypotheses. Necessary exceptions are not a full classification.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: For every k, two positive integers N<M have at least k common factor differences; exactly k distinct positive witnesses are constructed. Complete literal two-integer scope, independently reviewed.
gap_en: The original conjecture asking for k distinct integers remains unproved. Maintainers must decide whether the two-integer catalogue wording is the intended award scope; priority and acceptance remain unverified.
campaign_result: For every k, two positive integers N<M have at least k common factor differences; exactly k distinct positive witnesses are constructed. Complete literal two-integer scope, independently reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the union-of-multiples inequality for singleton and two-element sets and sets containing 2. Proves a conditional high-half insertion step and a counterexample to the nonmultiples misprint.
gap_en: The general finite-set inequality is not proved. The insertion step assumes n/2<a<=n, nondivisibility by old elements, and the stronger bound (n+1)B(m)<=2mB(n). The nonmultiples counterexample does not refute the original multiples question.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves k=2 and k=3 counterexamples outside the original k>=4 range. Proves the identity n(n+d)(n+2d)(n+3d)+d^4=(n^2+3nd+d^2)^2. Excludes square products when d^4+1<2(n^2+3nd+d^2), in particular for d>0 and n>=d^2, and for n>0,d=1. Derives a necessary primitive-Pythagorean condition for a hypothetical coprime four-term square-product counterexample.
gap_en: The original assertion for arbitrary progression length and perfect-power exponent remains unproved.
new_proved_result: Complete unconditional four-term square-product exclusion, with normalization and both infinite-descent branches.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves a finite distinct-modulus covering of N with moduli p-1 for primes p>=3, using twelve moduli including 2 and period 360.
gap_en: The original requires p>=5 and a covering of Z. The construction uses p=3; removing modulus 2 loses coverage of 2. The later integer-domain bridge still permits p=3 and does not resolve the prime-bound gap.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves the infinitely-many-n finite-representation question (parts.i), the Borwein-Loring construction and property, and two distinct infinite representations of 3/8, via (5,6,7,...) and (4,7,8,...).
gap_en: A single rational with continuum many representations and finite decomposition for every positive n remain unproved; quantifiers cannot be exchanged.
new_proved_result: For every finite r, a rational x_r has at least 2^r canonical infinite representations; each fiber has cardinality at most continuum.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves that every C4-free graph, on an arbitrary vertex type, has a countable decomposition into C6-free edge-color classes.
gap_en: The unconditional finite Ramsey C4/C6 input and complete classification are still missing. The new separation premise is explicit and unproved for the required pair.
campaign_result: New edge-cover count, extremal-to-Ramsey reduction and projective-plane threshold arithmetic are proved.

proved_en: Proves the negation of the every-n>3 multiplicity claim (parts.ii): at n=4 the maximum unit-distance count is 5 and every maximizer is equivalent under a plane isometry to a unit rhombus.
gap_en: The number of global maximizing configurations up to planar isometry tending to infinity is still unproved.
campaign_result: Proved faithful unit-distance edge count and a conditional bounded-degree non-maximizer criterion.

proved_en: Proves the Straus construction of 2^k isosceles-free points in R^k with at most 2^k-1 distinct distances, and the equivalence between one-dimensional isosceles triples and three-term arithmetic progressions.
gap_en: The fixed-plane asymptotic distance bound is not proved. Growing dimension with n does not answer it. The one-dimensional asymptotic reduction assumes the core Dumitrescu lower bound; the submitted targets do not prove that bound.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves block-pigeonhole and finite-run lemmas. For c2<2, supplies a run of prescribed length k when the (1+k)-th indexed prime is <=x. Derives the small-c1 logarithmic-run conclusion only under the explicit eventual block-count and sparse-bad-gap premise hBC.
gap_en: Arbitrary c2>=2 and the unrestricted original question remain unproved.
new_proved_result: Every positive c1 and every c2<2: all sufficiently large real x have more than c1 log x consecutive primes with every adjacent gap above c2.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves trajectory trapping and coalescence conditional on a barrier, infinitely many nonbarriers, and an equivalence and a conditional reduction for parts.ii using the Lau hypothesis.
gap_en: The analytic Lau premise remains unproved in Lean. The unconditional epsilon theorem and full original barrier scope remain incomplete.
campaign_result: Corrected the source attribution of Lau’s endpoints; proved the n-to-n-2 translation from the actual v3 1<k<n premise.

proved_en: Proves greedy and parabola Sidon constructions and an unconditional sqrt(N)/3 lower bound. Derives a near-optimal empty-start result only assuming Singer and the required prime-density input.
gap_en: The actual original exists-M near-sqrt(M) extension of every prescribed finite Sidon A remains unproved. A stronger all-large-M probe was also unsuccessful, but is not an extra user requirement.
campaign_result: Corrected the source header to mark arbitrary finite-start and near-optimal results incomplete. Diagnosed mixed triple conflicts.

proved_en: Proves existence and uniqueness of the minimum interval length, the lower bound n+1, the value at m=0, and periodicity under a common multiple. Derives parts.ii only under the van Doorn hypothesis hvd.
gap_en: Parts.i uniform n^(1+o(1)) upper bound remains unproved.
new_proved_result: Unconditional parts.ii, all sufficiently large n and explicit offset m=4n; no external gap hypothesis.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.

proved_en: Proves infinitely many n satisfy ((n+1)!)^2 | (2n)!, the k=1 variant.
gap_en: Neither mixed-factorial infinitude nor the squared-factorial conjecture for k>=2 is proved.
new_proved_result: Exact factorial/carry-count equivalence and offset carrying lemmas.
campaign_result: No new complete original solution in this campaign; retained results and exact gaps reviewed.
